note: The context-layers gate's placement exceptions (tools/src/gates/check-claude-md.ts reads it in a whole run; nothing generates from it). A CLAUDE.md belongs at the root, at the top of a governed directory or in a nested-layer folder — or it is named here. An entry is { name, match, reason, owner, since }: match is an exact path or a whole-path glob. It ships empty; the gate fails an entry that excuses nothing, so an entry is deleted in the change that removes its files. Edit this file, then run: make gate G=check-claude-md.
